objective: Make the persistent ChatGPT Instant front door the primary human interface while minimizing scarce model input, reasoning, and visible-output consumption without weakening durable authority, provenance, validation, or recovery.
principles: Workspace Control understands Workspace Control; leaf executors receive the smallest sufficient execution contract.
Choose the smallest capable executor and the smallest sufficient context/reasoning/output envelope.
WAITING is a control-plane state, not a reasoning activity; model budget is exactly zero while waiting.
Front-door chat prose is input/candidate state only and cannot mint or widen execution authority.
Durable state remains authoritative; persistent conversation context is only an optimization/cache.
Economy settings may reduce resource use but may never weaken safety, authority, validator, provenance, or recovery requirements.

context_modes.REF_ONLY: Inline only the irreducible leaf contract and content-addressed references; retrieve evidence on demand.
context_modes.DELTA: Reuse an explicitly bound durable base checkpoint and send only new/changed evidence and instructions.
context_modes.SELECTED: Inline/retrieve a bounded selected evidence set when the leaf cannot be solved from references alone.
context_modes.FULL_RECOVERY: Supply reconstructable durable state after session loss, unknown context, or explicit recovery requirement.

reasoning_profiles.NO_MODEL: No model invocation. Required for deterministic actions and external waits.
reasoning_profiles.ECONOMY: Default bounded reasoning for objective, validator-backed leaf work.
reasoning_profiles.STANDARD: Escalation after structured evidence demonstrates economy reasoning is insufficient.
reasoning_profiles.DEEP: Scarce/high-cost reasoning reserved for intrinsically difficult residual work and budget-permitted escalation.

communication_modes.MACHINE_MINIMAL: Structured result/evidence only; no preamble, play-by-play, waiting narration, or routine prose.
communication_modes.CONCISE: Short operational explanation when a human must understand a result.
communication_modes.USER_FACING: Front-door synthesis/status/decision presentation for the human operator.

primary_actions: submit high-level tasks in natural language
provide explicit human decisions when requested
request cancellation/revision through the durable control path
frontdoor_contract.authority_boundary: Front-door messages produce typed non-authoritative intake/decision candidates. Existing authority-owned policy remains the only source of executable authority.
frontdoor_contract.persistence: The front-door conversation should normally persist for usability, but any session may be replaced and reconstructed from durable task state.
frontdoor_contract.output_policy: User-facing concise progress is permitted; worker/internal narration is not.
frontdoor_contract.waiting_policy: The front door may present deterministic status from durable state, but must not burn model reasoning merely because an external job is still running.

implementation_slices.scope: TokenBudget, ContextPlan, TokenEconomyObservation, deterministic planner, zero-model waits/deterministic execution.
Instant front-door typed message and non-authoritative task-intake candidate contracts.
Bind token-economy decisions to packet compilation/materialization so compact/delta/recovery modes affect actual worker input.
Persist front-door intake/status/decision records through Workspace Control durable state and connect them to task creation/resume without chat-created authority.
Offline replay of A10/existing packets; compare old/new input bytes/tokens, repeated boilerplate, context mode, and zero-model wait invariants.
Only after E4-0 validation, run the minimum live subscription-Codex auth/calibration actions required for CODEX/ECON acceptance.

conservation_rule.codex_before_e4_0_complete: No exploratory live Codex benchmarking. Permit only an explicitly required auth/preflight probe; otherwise use deterministic tests/replay.
conservation_rule.output: Default worker communication is MACHINE_MINIMAL. No model-generated waiting/status chatter.
conservation_rule.context: Default leaf model work starts REF_ONLY; context expands only from structured need.
conservation_rule.reasoning: Default leaf model work starts ECONOMY; escalation requires objective failure/structured difficulty evidence and budget admission.

acceptance: No model call occurs for WAITING_EXTERNAL or deterministic executor work.
Worker leaf packet can be materially smaller than full recovery packet while preserving all non-droppable constraints/authority/validator/provenance obligations.
Persistent session uses DELTA only when an exact durable base checkpoint is bound; otherwise recovery fails closed to FULL_RECOVERY.
Front-door task submission creates non-authoritative durable intake and cannot create executable authority.
Front-door status/decision/cancel requests resolve against durable task identity/state rather than conversation memory.
Machine worker output can be bounded/structured without weakening validator evidence.
Real Codex calibration records input/reasoning/output/allowance fields when observable and leaves unknown mappings explicitly UNKNOWN.
